# RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.6.0 — Complete `.rshp` & RaggieSoft Reference Portal Guide (`llms-full.txt`)

## 1. CLI Commands (`rshbuild.exe`)

- `rshbuild.exe <project.rshp> [--out-dir=<dir>] [--with-vpat]`
- `rshbuild.exe --validate [--diagnostics=json] <project.rshp>`
- `rshbuild.exe --import <input.chm|.hhp|.hlp|.cnt|.hpj> --out-dir=<dir> [--format=markdown|html]`
- `rshbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec <dir>`

## 2. Canonical `.rshp` Manifest Grammar

```ini
; Plain-text comment-preserving RaggieSoft Help Studio project (.rshp)
[Project]
ModuleId                 = publisher.app-name
Name                     = Sample Application
Version                  = 1.0.0
Publisher                = Sample Studio
Description              = Offline F1 context help and web documentation.
DefaultTopic             = welcome
Language                 = en-US
OnlineDocsUrl            = https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio

[UI]
AccentPrimaryHex         = #0F766E
AccentSecondaryHex       = #D97706

[Build]
OutputDir                = out
StandaloneExeName        = SampleAppHelp.exe
BuildModulePack          = true
BuildStandaloneExe       = true
BuildWebPortal           = true
BuildSdkHeaders          = true
BuildVpatReport          = true

[Topic.welcome]
Title                    = Welcome & Quick Start
Category                 = Getting Started
Source                   = topics/welcome.md
Summary                  = Overview and keyboard shortcuts.
Keywords                 = welcome, f1, shortcuts

[Index.idx-f1]
Term                     = F1 Context Help
Category                 = Shortcuts
Badge                    = Key
Topic                    = welcome
Anchor                   = f1-routing

[ContextMap]
IDH_MAIN_WINDOW = 0x1001 | welcome
IDH_SETTINGS    = 0x1002 | welcome#f1-routing
```

## 3. Diagnostic Codes (`RSH001` – `RSH055`)
- `RSH001`: Malformed `.rshp` manifest syntax.
- `RSH002` / `RSH003` / `RSH008`: Missing `ModuleId`, zero topics, or invalid `DefaultTopic`.
- `RSH010`: Missing topic `.md` / `.html` source file on disk.
- `RSH015`: Skipped HTML heading hierarchy (`<h1>` -> `<h3>`, WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1).
- `RSH020`: `<img>` missing `alt` attribute (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1).
- `RSH025`: Unscrubbed Microsoft Word `MsoNormal` or hardcoded `color:black` inline style.
- `RSH030`: Broken internal topic link (`<a href="...">`).
- `RSH040` / `RSH041` / `RSH045`: Duplicate numeric `ContextId`, duplicate `IDH_*` symbol, or unknown target topic.
- `RSH055`: `AccentPrimaryHex` contrast below 4.5:1 vs `#FFFFFF` or 3.0:1 vs `#15203A` Dark Mode card.
